notes.notes:

[h1][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/About_Game.png?t=1657413170[/img][/h1]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/Features.png?t=1657413170[/img]
[list]
[*] Play as Biwar, a teenager from Papua island who adventures in the forbidden forest to discover the truth about a dragon and why his parents died. The game is set in a beautiful ancient Balinese environment and Papuan folklore is unique to Nusantara
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/EPCI_ENVIRONMENT.gif?t=1657413170[/img]

[*] Adventure to explore forgotten Balinese ancient mystical environment and solve puzzles using magic mechanics, such as Telekinesis power, red and blue elements, and Non-Euclidean puzzle
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/animasi_puzzles02.gif?t=1657413170[/img]

[*] Fight Mythology Creatures with a machete (Indonesian sword), shield, and bow of magic elements. Attack them with multi-style action and finally defeat the dragon
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/stylized_combat02.gif?t=1657413170[/img]
[/list]

notes.title: Biwar Legend Of Dragon Slayer Alpha Demo Live Stream and Talks with Developers.
notes.notes:
These are pre-recorded footages, we are going to broadcast some playthroughs and trailers. If you have any questions, Feel free to ask us anything via chat!

[b][h1]About The Game[/h1][/b]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/Biwar.gif?t=1628993703[/img]
[b]Biwar Legend of Dragon Slayer[/b] is an [b]Action-Adventure[/b] game that invites you to explore the puzzles, Inspired by [b]Papuans folklore[/b] and the [b]Balinese ancient[/b] and ruins the environment. The third-person game will give you a whole experience of fight the [b]Indonesian Mythology Creatures [/b]in a fantasy realm and facing [b]traversal[/b] such a climbing on the ledge, Jump through the obstacle, Traps, and many more. [b]Linear path game![/b] the player doesn’t need a map to find their destiny. 

[b][h2]Features[/h2][/b][olist]
[*] Fantasy, realistic 3D style, and beautiful ancient environment
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/1.gif?t=1628993703[/img]
[*] Environment Puzzle
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/2.gif?t=1628993703[/img]
[*] Combat
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1680800/extras/3.gif?t=1628993703[/img]
[/olist]
